title: Hero Stats Page added, Calculator removed

changes.text: Added a Hero Stats page with a sortable, filterable overview of every hero's combat stats for fast side-by-side comparison.
Removed the Skill Damage Calculator page and its teaser; the feature was deprecated in favor of the new Hero Stats overview.
Added a calendar page that shows all possible upcoming hero releases.

title: Delusion Den Guide, Virtue Overview and Hero Virtue Suggestions

changes.text: Added a Delusion Den Guide with mode-specific tips, priority targets, and practical decision support for safer weekly clears.
Added a dedicated Virtue Overview page including set thresholds, farming and upgrade flow, Realm Rover context, and a complete set database.
Extended hero detail pages with recommended Virtue set suggestions so each hero now has clearer build direction for primary, secondary, and tertiary setups.
I added a new Tower Guide for progression, teams and tips.
Restructured the guide and tips with new insights and a new layout.

title: Added a stats Page for all heroes

changes.text: In order to see and compare all stats from all heroes another page was added. Also you can turn on a bonus toggle, to see heroes with sample bonus data which is more accurate.
Calculator Page added - now all hero skills display the raw dmg numbers of a base (Level 300/No Items/Div 5 Hero.
Register and Login added (alpha). You can now register free and get a new page -> my heroes. There you can select and save heroes that you have.
